notes: v2.5.42. On hold shows in the Status column with a red outline and tint, parts can be put on hold from the row menu, and a hold on a released part holds its CNC cards, RP cards and travelers and tells the PM and lead. The mBOM and the 3D viewer show holds, 3D search narrows the model again and reads descriptions, and the mBOM follows eBOM changes within a minute. Tree or Flat with assembly context, assemblies show the dates under them, Gantt filters, tools in the zone row, and descriptions edit in the Plan view. Quotes show their linked company and the Quote # filter is one search box. Recipient groups ask before dropping edits, RP activity finds every event, report windows start at the right time, and milestone, CMF document, conference room, linked copy, shared sign-in and 2D drawing access follow their rules.
